entities.summary: Kenturah Davis is an American contemporary multidisciplinary artist and designer. She works in the mediums of sculpture, drafting, printmaking, painting, and performance art. Davis has lived between the cities of Los Angeles and New Haven in the United States, and Accra, Ghana.
